Product-master products that are unclassified or whose declared and measured dimensions disagree (ADR 0020). An unknown kind or a cursor product-master rejects is a 400, product-master unreachable is a 502, and an unwired use case (PRODUCT_MASTER_MCP_ENDPOINT unset) is a 503.
